WITH obs_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM obs_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.observstation,
    oc.telescope_count,
    CAST(oc.telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT CAST(total AS REAL) FROM total_telescopes) as share
  FROM obs_counts oc
),
avg_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  AVG(s.telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(s.share) as avg_share,
  AVG(s.share - (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share_value)) as avg_excess_share
FROM shares s
WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share_value)
